mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) signals lower discount rates on equity cash flows, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to rise significantly above baseline in easing periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE increase above 5.5% triggers positive S&P 500 returns as tighter labor markets boost consumer confidence and corporate profits.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross 5.5% threshold, or returns do not rise when triggered.

mechanism_narrative: Strong supply growth (INDPRO rising) indicates robust corporate production, expanding profit margins and equity valuations over 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO fails to continue rising, or 60-day returns do not outperform baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (demand units) simultaneously signal strong consumer and business demand, compressing discount rates and boosting equity returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or HOUST falls while the other rises, or returns do not follow.

mechanism_narrative: Falling FEDFUNDS (easing) paired with rising INDPRO (supply growth) creates dual tailwinds: lower rates and stronger earnings, driving positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises while INDPRO falls, or returns do not follow.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in PAYEMS (employment) and falls in UNRATE (unemployment) signal a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: Either PAYEMS falls or UNRATE rises while the other moves favorably, or returns do not follow.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS), higher interest rates reduce discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises in a tightening cycle but returns are positive, or returns do not decline as expected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDPC1 (total demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) both signal strong consumer and business demand, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or RSAFS falls while the other rises, or returns do not follow.
